crossRefs.note: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

parallels.note: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in…

translations.web: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,
translations.bsb: For six years you are to sow your land and gather its produce,
translations.kjv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the fruits
translations.asv: And six years thou shalt sow thy land, and shalt gather in the increase thereof:
